remaining_reviewer_opportunities.description: Extract a central proposed interface with complete numerical hypotheses, source locator and a nontrivial hypothesis check.
remaining_reviewer_opportunities.disposition: Retained explicitly in the reader audit. The new shared-residue miniature improves explanation but does not complete this stronger extraction. The reviewer identifies it as an extension rather than a demonstrated mathematical error or a requirement to validate all source proofs.

visual_review: Latest 25 pages rendered with Poppler at 1200-pixel scale and inspected in three contact sheets. Both Table 1 pages and following text inspected separately at 1600-pixel scale: all eight rows clearly separated, rules span all four columns, no split row, and no overlap with the caption or following section. This supersedes the earlier layout review.
novelty_assessment: The magnitude of proposed conclusions, inherited machinery, and specific newly proposed bridges are assessed separately. Contrastive tests and a comparison register operationalize the synthesis.
disclosure: Approved disclosure appears once, in its dedicated section; absent from abstract.
validation_scope: Bibliographic identity, source-statement comparison, elementary illustrative examples, internal exposition cross-review, compilation and rendered layout. Underlying release proofs and formal dependency builds are outside these checks.
record_type: Reproduction and internal-audit result; public release status is maintained in publication records.
